reference: The attached photos are references for form, space and mood only. Carry their design language into a new stand that is clearly more premium and refined, in the brand colours above.
logo_panel: One plain panel in a brand colour is left empty for the logo, which is added later.
no_lettering: No lettering, numbers, names, emblems or logos anywhere; screens, product labels and signs are plain.
do_not_copy: Do not copy any logo, lettering, slogan, poster or other brand from the photos, or anything from neighbouring stands.
graphic_no_text: No text, letters, numbers, logos, emblems, signatures or watermarks anywhere in the artwork; any label, screen, sign or package in it is plain.
graphic_text_area: The empty area for the text stays calm and plain, free of objects, patterns and fine detail, and the subject never reaches into it.
graphic_ref: The attached photos show the product only for its shape, proportions, materials and colours; redraw it in the style of this artwork, never paste or trace the photo, and leave out every label, logo and lettering on it.
